recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, low-key portrait of two figures in an intimate, protective embrace against a void-black background. The lighting is cool-toned and directional, emphasizing pale skin textures and intense facial expressions, paired with a mix of clean serif metadata and a large, distressed, custom-lettered title at the base.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical stacking of faces creating a diagonal line of sight
Contrast between pale, desaturated skin and deep black negative space
Juxtaposition of clean, small-scale metadata with large, textured title
Protective physical proximity suggesting tension and intimacy
coreInvariants: Cool, desaturated color palette with localized warm accents in eyes/lips
High-contrast directional lighting from the upper right

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two subjects occupy the central and right two-thirds of the frame; the upper figure leans over the lower figure.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The lower figure's face, specifically the eyes, serves as the primary emotional anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the upper figure's downward gaze, follows the bridge of the nose to the lower figure's face, then drops to the large title at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy negative space on the left and top edges to isolate the subjects.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black background for isolation and mood.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Subtle amber in the eyes and muted red in the lips.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with extreme value contrast between highlights and shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Strictly limited to cool greys, blacks, and desaturated skin tones

letterConstructionRules: Distressed, stone-like or weathered texture within the glyphs
Custom flourishes like spirals or sharp, thorn-like serifs
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'g' features a decorative spiral descender
The 't' and 'l' have extended vertical stems that cross the baseline and x-height
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a clean, authoritative Roman serif with a gritty, illustrative display face.
graphicDevices: Thin vertical lines extending from letters
Subtle grain overlay across the entire composition

preserve: Distressed texture of the main title
Wide tracking of the secondary text

candidateDirections.reason: For the clean, classical metadata text.
For the base skeleton of the distressed title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a low-key portrait of a pale man with dark hair leaning over a woman with long wavy brown hair. Use cool, blue-tinted lighting from the side. Background must be pure black. The man has intense amber eyes. The woman looks forward with a somber expression. High film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in a large, distressed, silver-grey serif font at the bottom, featuring elongated stems and a spiral on the 'g'. Add secondary metadata in a small, clean, all-caps serif font in the top left, stacked vertically with wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the skin tone desaturated and pale?
Does the title text have a weathered, stone-like texture?
Is the metadata text vertically stacked and left-aligned?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the blue color cast
Amount of distress/erosion on the title font
Tightness of the crop on the subjects' faces

mustAchieve: Tactile texture in the display typography

postGenerationChecks: Check for high-value contrast between skin and background
Ensure metadata tracking is wide enough to feel 'cinematic'
Verify the 'g' spiral flourish is present in the title
Confirm the overall mood is melancholic and gothic
recipe.reuseFormula: Low-key Portrait + Classical Serif Metadata + Distressed Gothic Title + Desaturated Cool Palette
